# HolyCrab Agent Tools v0.5.0

Add MiniMax H3 Max, Agnes Video 2.5, and Agnes Image 2.5 Flash to the shared CLI/MCP release snapshot: 7 video, 4 image, and 1 audio models. Requests use each model's native HolyCrab fields and exact estimate/create routes. Account results expose valid `disabled_models`; unknown permission is never treated as granted access.

Retain one-shot paid submission, uncertain-outcome recovery, public-output filtering, and Windows DPAPI credential protection. Both Unix and Windows installers verify SHA-256 hashes. Publish only after the Generate contract, recorded real-person acceptance, and native installation gates pass. Ken confirmed reuse of prior real-person authorization/upload acceptance for this model-only release; unchanged core code is checked by a pinned fingerprint. No new live real-person test or successful live generation is claimed. Website installers must match immutable Release assets byte for byte.
